name: software-workflows
description: Agent-teams orchestration with Codex as the cross-model advisor and writer: the Codex Oracle MCP server (architect_review, code_review, research, codex_query, abraham and its run tools) and the hooks that gate plan mode and git push on a Codex review.

office.title: Codex Office: when to show it
office.description: The Codex Office is the live pixel view of your Codex runs, in your browser at http://127.0.0.1:8765/; watching it costs no tokens. open (default): start it the first time a session uses a Codex tool, and open it in your browser once per session. background: start it the same way, but never open the browser. off: never start it automatically; /software-workflows:office still starts it. The SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_OFFICE environment variable, when set, overrides this for the sessions that have it.

writer_mcp_servers.title: Writer MCP servers
writer_mcp_servers.description: Writer MCP servers: all (default), or a JSON list of exact server names. Changes apply at the next coordinator start.

writer_park_idle_seconds.title: Writer idle parking delay
writer_park_idle_seconds.description: Seconds of native inactivity before verified unload and parking. Default 1800; 0 disables idle-timer parking. Finished quiet writers and memory-pressure candidates are still reclaimed. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_WRITER_PARK_IDLE_SECONDS overrides this setting.

writer_reclaim_concurrency.title: Concurrent writer reclamations
writer_reclaim_concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous verified writer parks and quarantine retirements. Must be a positive integer; default 2. Excess candidates remain queued. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_WRITER_RECLAIM_CONCURRENCY overrides this setting. Changes apply at the next coordinator start.

retention_rows.title: Archive selection rows
retention_rows.description: Positive scheduling slice for lossless archive selection; default 1024. Byte and elapsed budgets also apply. No evidence is discarded at this limit. Changes apply at coordinator start; SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_ROWS overrides this setting.

retention_bytes.title: Archive selection bytes
retention_bytes.description: Positive logical-byte scheduling slice; default 8388608 (8 MiB). A larger row runs alone asynchronously and is reported. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_BYTES overrides this setting.

retention_delete_rows.title: Archive deletion rows
retention_delete_rows.description: Positive maximum rows per short delete transaction; default 64, also bounded by the selection byte and elapsed budgets. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_DELETE_ROWS overrides this setting.

retention_seconds.title: Compaction cooperative slice
retention_seconds.description: Positive seconds before yielding or ending a delete transaction; default 0.05. An individual SQLite statement or commit cannot be preempted; actual maxima are reported. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_SECONDS overrides this setting.

retention_wal_high_bytes.title: Compaction WAL pause threshold
retention_wal_high_bytes.description: Pause compaction at this many outstanding WAL bytes; default 134217728 (128 MiB). Observed without checkpointing. Must exceed the low threshold. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_WAL_HIGH_BYTES overrides this setting.

retention_wal_low_bytes.title: Compaction WAL resume threshold
retention_wal_low_bytes.description: Resume compaction below this many outstanding WAL bytes; default 33554432 (32 MiB). Positive and below the high threshold. SOFTWARE_WORKFLOWS_RETENTION_WAL_LOW_BYTES overrides this setting.

memory_warn_ratio.title: Memory compression warning ratio
memory_warn_ratio.description: Pause new native launches at this compressor ratio; kernel warning pressure alone parks idle writers without pausing launches. Default 0.50; must be below the critical ratio.

memory_critical_ratio.title: Memory compression critical ratio
memory_critical_ratio.description: Refuse new native launches at this compressor ratio, or kernel critical pressure. Default 0.62.
